panel.title: Aurora

settings.title: Aurora AI features
settings.description: Every Aurora AI feature is off until an Admin turns it on. Restricted fields and medical records are never sent to a model, and customer data is never used for training.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.description: Answers questions about your records with links to them. Cmd or Ctrl+J in Atlas, the More menu in Compass.

plain_language.label: Ask in plain language
plain_language.description: Turns a sentence into a saved view or filter and shows the filter it built.

extraction.label: Document extraction
extraction.description: Reads riders, insurance certificates, invoices, receipts and quotes into fields for you to confirm.

drafting.label: Drafting
drafting.description: Drafts SOPs, advance packets, emails, day sheets and change order descriptions in your verbiage.

summaries.label: Summaries
summaries.description: Summarizes a record's activity, a project's week and gate readiness.

mapping.label: Mapping help
mapping.description: Suggests import column mappings and catalog bindings for unknown scanned codes.
